scripts/binary_payload.py

Python · Tier B

Archive the staged runtime and compile its native Go bootstrap.

Usage

The builder calls make_payload/compile_bootstrap after staging an image.

Inputs

Go executable/source, image, relocation paths, metadata, output and SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH.

Side effects

Writes a normalized gzip/tar payload and integrity inventory, invokes Go build in the supplied work directory, and creates the requested executable.

Cleanup

The parent builder owns archive, bootstrap work tree and release output retention.

@see scripts/binary_builder.py

@see docs/binary-distribution.md

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
make_payload 25 Write a normalized archive and return the exact per-file integrity inventory. Reject links/special files; record hashes, modes, expansion size and relocation markers so the bootstrap can verify the image before starting its interpreter.
compile_bootstrap 63 Not yet documented
